follow-up time: Variable, up to first expulsion or last follow-up visit between 1980 and 2013
exposure: Parous women who had experienced their first IUC expulsion (n=1786)
cohort: Women who had a TCu-IUD or LNG-IUS inserted between 1980 and 2013 and had at least one follow-up visit (n = 19,697).
finding: Age under 25 years, having had less than two deliveries and being users of Cu-IUD were significantly associated with IUC expulsion.
